scx_lavd.title: LAVD (Latency-Aware Virtual Deadline)
scx_lavd.tagline: Optimized for frame pacing and low input latency.
scx_lavd.summary: Measures each task's latency criticality dynamically and modulates its virtual deadline and time slice, routing tasks across scheduling domains partitioned per LLC, per core type (Intel P/E, ARM big.LITTLE) and per NUMA node. Uses scx_bpf_now() to cut hardware TSC reads by ~76%. Author: Changwoo Min / Igalia.

scx_bpfland.title: BPFland (Interactive vruntime Scheduler)
scx_bpfland.tagline: Low-latency scheduling for smooth gaming and desktop responsiveness.
scx_bpfland.summary: Derived from scx_rustland but runs the engine entirely in in-kernel eBPF (a thin Rust harness handles parameters and telemetry only). Tasks are sorted in a dual-tier weighted-vruntime topology: threads whose voluntary context-switch rate crosses a threshold are classified interactive, get priority queues, and receive an unused-time-slice carryover budget for bursty frame pacing.

scx_cake.title: CAKE (DRR++ 4-Tier CPU Scheduler)
scx_cake.tagline: Network-inspired deficit round robin for smooth gaming.
scx_cake.summary: Adapts the network CAKE queue's Deficit Round Robin++ (DRR++) to CPU threads via a 4-tier classification driven by an EWMA of runtime duration (Critical <100us, Interactive <2ms, Frame <8ms, Bulk >=8ms) with 10% deadband hysteresis. Avoids global atomics using per-CPU BSS with MESI cache-line isolation, kernel-delegated idle selection, and per-LLC DSQ sharding. Author: RitzDaCat.

scx_cosmos.title: Cosmos (Adaptive Locality & Saturation Scheduler)
scx_cosmos.tagline: Balanced throughput and responsiveness for desktop and server.
scx_cosmos.summary: Lightweight and adaptive: under normal load tasks are pinned to local per-CPU DSQs (maximizing cache hits, avoiding shared-queue spinlocks); on detected saturation it shifts to a global/per-NUMA earliest-deadline-first shared queue for work conservation. Batches/defers wakeups via a timer to prevent enqueue interrupt storms, using micro time-slices. Author: Andrea Righi.

scx_p2dq.title: P2DQ (Pick-Two Multi-Queue Scheduler)
scx_p2dq.tagline: Datacenter-tested load balancer with multi-layer topology queues.
scx_p2dq.summary: General-purpose 'Power-of-Two Choices' (Pick-2) load balancer implemented entirely in BPF with BPF Arenas for dynamic task state. Each LLC domain keeps three queues (main, interactive for low-utilization tasks, migration); a CPU checks local-LLC queues in order and, when empty, samples two LLCs and steals from the heavier migration queue. Supports hybrid P/E routing via a sched_core_priority min-heap; does NOT support CPU hotplugging. Author: Daniel Hodges (Meta).

scx_tickless.title: Tickless (HPC & Virtualization Scheduler)
scx_tickless.tagline: Tickless compute cores for jitter-free server execution.
scx_tickless.summary: Server-oriented: a small housekeeping pool of primary CPUs (default CPU 0, --primary-domain) handles all scheduling events, timer ticks and queue routing, while worker CPUs run tickless with long/infinite slices (SCX_SLICE_INF) and receive preemption IPIs only on contention. Fully suppressing ticks requires the host kernel booted with nohz_full. Unsuitable for interactive desktop/gaming. Author: Andrea Righi.

scx_beerland.title: Beerland (Locality-Aware Non-blocking Dispatcher)
scx_beerland.tagline: Scalable, cache-local scheduling for high-core systems.
scx_beerland.summary: Prioritizes cache residency and scalable dispatch: per-CPU DSQs ordered by virtual deadline, with tasks pinned to their local core under normal load (migration only at wakeup via select_cpu). Under saturation it switches to distributed work-stealing - idle cores steal the earliest-deadline task from remote per-CPU DSQs, balancing work conservation with lock-free local execution. Author: Andrea Righi.

scx_flash.title: Flash (Earliest Deadline First Fairness)
scx_flash.tagline: Predictable, fair-share latency scheduling for audio and multimedia.
scx_flash.summary: EDF scheduler focused on strict fair-share and predictable latency under overcommit: each thread carries a latency weight that increments when it releases its slice early (advancing its virtual deadline) and decays when it exhausts the full slice, so bursty interactive work preempts compute-bound bulk work. Author: Andrea Righi.

scx_flow.title: Flow (Budget-Driven Deterministic Scheduler)
scx_flow.tagline: Zero-heuristic, bandwidth-allocated scheduling with real-time web telemetry.
scx_flow.summary: Budget-driven with no heuristic classification: sleeping tasks accumulate execution budget, running tasks consume it monotonically, and each thread gets an equal share of core bandwidth (fair sharing, no priority inversion, no starvation). Wakeups bypass intermediate layers via immediate SCX_DSQ_LOCAL_ON dispatch; re-enqueues enter a per-CPU vtime-ordered 'Waiting Room' with slice clamped to [50us, 2ms]. Ships a live web dashboard. Author: Galih Tama.

scx_forge.title: Forge (AI-Agent Dynamic Optimizer)
scx_forge.tagline: Adaptive scheduling tuned dynamically via user-space telemetry agents.
scx_forge.summary: Experimental agent-driven scheduler: an efficient in-kernel BPF dispatcher provides the low-overhead data path while a companion user-space process (scx_forge_agent) monitors hardware telemetry (cache misses, IPC, branch mispredictions) and adjusts dispatch parameters in a closed loop. Scales across enterprise NUMA and GPU-adjacent hosts; agent feedback loops can lag on phase changes. Author: Andrea Righi.

scx_pandemonium.title: Pandemonium (Behavioral Interconnect Scheduler)
scx_pandemonium.tagline: Advanced interconnect-aware scheduler with CoDel latency protection.
scx_pandemonium.summary: Behavioral adaptive scheduler with 3-tier classification (idle placement via kick preemption, cache-hot wakeup placement, batch overflow isolation), L2/L3 affinity tracking, CoDel sojourn enforcement, and automated process learning, built on a hybrid C23/eBPF engine with an async Rust control loop. Cross-domain work-stealing is gated by an effective-resistance metric (Reff) and a precomputed graph-conductance cut price (Phi). Author: William Clingan.

scx_rustland.title: Rustland (User-Space Reference Scheduler)
scx_rustland.tagline: Educational user-space scheduling engine built in Rust.
scx_rustland.summary: Hybrid reference scheduler: a user-space Rust daemon makes the primary scheduling decisions - tracking voluntary context switches, computing dynamic priority weights, and ordering tasks by weighted vruntime - over a minimal BPF shim (scx_rustland_core) that relays lifecycle events via ring buffers and shared maps. Substantial kernel-user IPC overhead makes it unsuitable for low-latency audio or high-throughput I/O; best for prototyping and study. Author: Andrea Righi.

scx_rusty.title: Rusty (Multi-Domain LLC Load Balancer)
scx_rusty.tagline: Hybrid round-robin cache domain scheduling with user-space balancing.
scx_rusty.summary: Multi-domain hybrid: the execution path runs in kernel BPF doing fast round-robin dispatch within LLC-mapped domains, while an async user-space Rust daemon computes per-domain load factors and writes cross-domain migration directives into the lb_data kernel map. Migration directives lag sudden workload transitions, and high task-weight disparities can cause infeasible-weight issues. Author: Tejun Heo.

Auto.description: Runs the scheduler with its default values. No special tuning is applied, making it the baseline the other profiles deviate from.

byScheduler.scx_lavd: Runs LAVD in autopilot mode, dynamically balancing latency criticality without manual tuning.
byScheduler.scx_beerland: Uses Beerland's balanced default, combining local pinning with distributed work-stealing under saturation.
byScheduler.scx_pandemonium: Runs Pandemonium in its default adaptive mode, letting the interconnect-aware heuristics self-tune.

Gaming.description: Favors interactive responsiveness with shorter time-slices and performance-oriented CPU behavior, tuned for frame pacing and low input latency.

byScheduler.scx_lavd: Enables LAVD's performance mode with a pinned 500 us slice for steady frame pacing.
byScheduler.scx_bpfland: Runs BPFland in performance mode with wakeup preemption for responsive interactive threads.
byScheduler.scx_cake: Selects CAKE's gaming profile for interactive frame delivery.
byScheduler.scx_cosmos: Raises Cosmos' slice to 700 us for smoother interactive performance.
byScheduler.scx_p2dq: Enables P2DQ task slicing and performance scheduling mode for low-latency dispatch.
byScheduler.scx_tickless: Applies Tickless' non-standard gaming frequency and slice settings. Not recommended for interactive desktop use.

Powersave.description: Favors energy efficiency with a low-power CPU mode and longer slice quanta, reducing wakeups and inter-processor traffic.

byScheduler.scx_lavd: Switches LAVD to powersave mode with a pinned 500 us slice.
byScheduler.scx_bpfland: Runs BPFland in powersave mode with a 20000 us slice and lowered interactivity thresholds.
byScheduler.scx_cake: Selects CAKE's battery profile for energy-efficient dispatch.
byScheduler.scx_cosmos: Runs Cosmos in powersave CPU mode.
byScheduler.scx_p2dq: Switches P2DQ to efficiency scheduling mode.
byScheduler.scx_tickless: Lowers Tickless' housekeeping cadence to reduce wakeups and energy use.

Lowlatency.description: Favors minimal wakeup and queue latency with performance CPU mode and wakeup-preemption behavior.

byScheduler.scx_lavd: Enables LAVD's performance mode with a pinned 500 us slice for minimal latency.
byScheduler.scx_bpfland: Runs BPFland in performance mode with wakeup preemption.
byScheduler.scx_cake: Selects CAKE's esports profile for minimal sojourn latency.
byScheduler.scx_cosmos: Raises Cosmos' slice to 700 us with performance mode and wakeup preemption.
byScheduler.scx_p2dq: Enables P2DQ yield-on-idle and task-slice flags for fast dispatch.
byScheduler.scx_tickless: Applies Tickless' lower-latency frequency and slice settings.

Server.description: Favors sustained throughput with longer slices, strict CPU-affinity prioritization, and keep-running semantics.

byScheduler.scx_lavd: Runs LAVD in performance mode with 3000-10000 us slice bounds and a pinned 3000 us slice for sustained throughput.
byScheduler.scx_bpfland: Runs BPFland with a 20000 us slice and strict CPU-affinity prioritization.
byScheduler.scx_p2dq: Enables P2DQ keep-running behavior to keep loaded cores busy.
byScheduler.scx_tickless: Sets Tickless' housekeeping frequency for steady server operation.
